Your AI keys. All translation is done by AI: with one key it works alone, with more keys a chapter is split between them by each key\'s strength and every page\'s weight, so it finishes faster. A key that is busy or out of quota rests and its work goes to the others. Each key is checked by itself: speed, model and how much is left today.

Fast: the team translates, the collection and the automatic checks fix what they can. Accurate: the same, then the strongest key reviews the whole chapter and fixes mistakes (one more request per chapter, better quality).
Keys that can read images also get the page pictures, so they see who is speaking and the text the OCR missed. Better translation, a bit more quota.

Every AI call of the app goes through one router. The page you are reading always goes first, even while chapters are translated in the background; then chapters and the review, then chat and search, then the home screen. The last 20% of every key's daily quota is kept for translation, so chat and the home screen never use it up. A key set to Automatic uses a light model for chat and extras and its strongest model for the review. A call that fails moves to the next key at once, and a key that keeps failing rests longer each time. Every key also learns how many calls it can run at once: it adds a little after each answer and halves at the first \"too busy\". While you read, if the first key is slow on a page, a second key races it and the first good answer wins. Chapters queued for translation keep going in the background, even after the app is closed.

Translate the next chapter by itself

While you read, the next chapter is translated in the background when the team has at least 3 working keys with quota left. It starts at 35% of the chapter, never on low battery, battery saver or without internet, and never slows the page you are reading. The translation library is used first; only what is missing goes to the AI.

At night, while the phone charges on Wi-Fi, new chapters of the works in your library are translated so they are ready in the morning. Only works from English sources: Arabic sources and chapters already translated are skipped. At most 2 new chapters per work and 20 a night, never more than 70% of each key\'s daily quota.

Up to 12 lines a chapter (doubtful ones, new names, system windows, lines saved with more than one meaning) are translated again by another key, and the better translation is kept: the one that follows the glossary and the codex, leaves no English, fits its bubble, passes the quality check and agrees with the character\'s gender.
Save the translation when a chapter is read

When you finish a chapter or mark it read, every line of its translation that the translation library does not have yet is saved there, so opening it again (or the same lines in another work) needs no AI.
After its lines are safe in the library, the chapter\'s own translation file is deleted. The translation library, glossary, work dictionary, lessons, summaries, names and templates are never deleted.
Off by default so chapters you downloaded for offline reading stay. When on, a read chapter\'s downloaded pages are deleted too.
